name: C11_PI_SINGLE_VERTEX_LIST3_BACKDOOR_GATE_V1

residual_component_class.name: C_C11
residual_component_class.definition: Connected components C of the remaining undecided induced graph arising from an authoritative-core C11 survivor pair after fixing one assignment (gamma,delta) in {3,4}^2, exact boundary-list propagation, and only already-frozen/source-faithful preprocessing, for which the 0-L3/global-missing-color terminal has not yet applied.

definition.one_L3_backdoor: A vertex r in V(C) is a 1-L3-backdoor if for every kappa in the exact current list L_C(r), after fixing r=kappa and deterministic exact propagation, every branch either reaches immediate contradiction or every surviving undecided connected component D has a globally missing color c_D in [4] absent from all lists in D.
branch_terminal_success: CONTRADICTION: an exact empty-list/improper-fixed-edge certificate is reached.
L3_READY: every surviving undecided connected component has a globally missing color and therefore falls under the frozen P7-free List-3 primitive.
definition.graph_discovery: Search r exhaustively over V(C); for each r search every kappa in L_C(r). The structural backdoor test uses only exact propagation, connected components, and global-missing-color checks; no extension oracle.

universal_target: Prove or refute, relative to the frozen C11 residual class, that every C in C_C11 has a graph-discoverable 1-L3-backdoor.
polynomiality_if_universal: At most |V(C)| candidate backdoor vertices are tested.
Each candidate has at most four color branches.
Every structural branch test is polynomial.
Once a certified backdoor r is found, feasibility of C is the disjunction over at most four branches, each solved by contradiction or polynomial P7-free List-3 calls.

Thus a universal backdoor-number<=1 theorem would make every previously unresolved fixed-pair component polynomially solvable and would close the corresponding Pi-bit computation route without a 4-color oracle.

B1_UNIVERSAL_SINGLE_VERTEX_BACKDOOR.label: B1_SINGLE_VERTEX_BACKDOOR_FOUND_UNIVERSALLY
pass_requires: A proof from frozen authoritative-core hypotheses that every C in C_C11 has at least one 1-L3-backdoor.
A polynomial graph-only procedure for finding such an r.
For every branch kappa in L(r), exact proof that propagation ends in contradiction or L3_READY.
If this covers all four assignments for every survivor pair, D1_PI_POLY_DISCOVERABLE and then frozen P3 may be promoted only with a separate exact binding receipt.

B2_CERTIFIED_NO_SINGLE_VERTEX_BACKDOOR.label: B2_NO_SINGLE_VERTEX_BACKDOOR
B2_CERTIFIED_NO_SINGLE_VERTEX_BACKDOOR.condition: A concrete authoritative-core residual component C is found for which exhaustive testing of every r in V(C) proves that r is not a 1-L3-backdoor.
certificate: exact provenance of the frozen survivor pair and fixed assignment producing C
exact graph of C and all current lists
for every r in V(C), one bad color kappa in L(r)
for each selected (r,kappa), exact post-propagation state
certificate that branch is not already contradiction
proof no further already-frozen deterministic propagation/preprocessing applies before the L3 terminal test
B2_CERTIFIED_NO_SINGLE_VERTEX_BACKDOOR.interpretation: This proves backdoor number >1 for that component relative to the frozen terminal/preprocessing stack only. It does not imply hardness or absence of another polynomial algorithm.

B3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.label: B3_GATE_UNRESOLVED
B3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.condition: Neither a universal B1 theorem nor a complete B2 certificate is established.
B3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.interpretation: Authority/implementation/theorem gap only; no mathematical negation.

positive_control.scope: all frozen false-twin blow-up members, all selected survivor pairs, all four fixed assignments

negative_control_requirement.purpose: Prevent an implementation from accepting one successful color branch as a backdoor.
negative_control_requirement.required_property: Synthetic/control component must contain a tested vertex r for which at least one color branch is L3_READY and at least one color branch is NOT L3_READY; checker must reject r because the definition is universal over all kappa in L(r).

anti_cheat: Backdoor condition is forall kappa in L(r), not exists kappa.
A branch is not terminal merely because every individual list has size <=3.
General P7-free List-4/4-coloring or precoloring extension calls are forbidden.
No extension oracle or hidden extension coloring may be used to choose r or kappa.
A single positive fixture does not establish B1.
Failure to find B1 in finite search is not B2 unless the exact exhaustive component certificate is produced.
next_action: Separate authorization required. Audit only universal 1-L3-backdoor structure or produce an exact B2 countercomponent.
